Welcome to Canine Fitness LLC! 🐶💪 We specialize in keeping dogs happy, healthy, and active with our nutritious homemade treats, indoor running sessions on non-motorized treadmills, and relaxing dog massage therapy. Whether your pup is full of energy or needs gentle rehabilitation, we provide customized care for dogs of all ages.

Join us on our journey to promote better health and mobility for every pup! Follow for tips, behind-the-scenes, and happy tails! 🐾✨

📍 Serving SoCal-Beaumont, Yucaipa, Calimesa | 📩 Www.caninefitnessllc.com
